selection_provenance: Nominated after 85 configurations were evaluated; adaptive frontier repair, not independent confirmation
motivation: Improve thickness and point low-qc recognition while retaining strong continuous amplitude bases

distribution_protocol.analog_atoms: base + 0.5*(revealed whole curve - weighted mean revealed whole curve)
distribution_protocol.weights: Gaussian horizontal kernel; scale median nonzero support pair distance; divide by near-group size
distribution_protocol.loo_exclusion: Entire location, near group and colocated coordinates; recomputed from support only
distribution_protocol.joint_model: One atom index is shared by every depth; enumerate finite support exactly, no random simulation
distribution_protocol.quantile_convention: Lower inverse empirical CDF; no interpolation between counts
distribution_protocol.point_median: Marginal logqc median minimizes expected absolute point error under the stipulated mixture
distribution_protocol.thickness_median: Median of whole-atom low-cell counts minimizes expected absolute thickness error under the same mixture
distribution_protocol.event_location_decision: At selected count, top marginal probabilities minimize expected Hamming loss; base-value ties minimize changes
distribution_protocol.probability: Exact marginal P(atom logqc < 0), before common external calibration
distribution_protocol.transport_assumptions: Analog deviations or LOO-IDW whole-profile errors transfer to the frozen amplitude base; not its own calibrated residuals
distribution_protocol.limits: Only 5-13 support profiles; horizontal nonstationarity and source-model mismatch can invalidate transport
distribution_protocol.validation_scope: Exploration on repeatedly used frozen validation sites
distribution_protocol.source_relationship: Functional/bootstrap curve dependence inspires the construction; this spatial finite mixture does not reproduce their estimators or inherit their validity guarantees

point_inputs: Only frozen keys and pred_log_qc from the two named point caches
joint_head: Exact marginal event probability of the same finite whole-curve mixture
empirical_source: Frozen native p_low_1 only; no OOF risk probability or intervals
empirical_head_interpretation: Independent existing support-error event head paired with a new point decision
head: joint
